arguments.recommended_next_step: Continue investigating the root causes of job failures to prevent future occurrences. Monitor the retry queue to ensure it remains unblocked and report any new issues to the team.
arguments.summary: Resolved the issue with the retry queue being blocked by 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table. Deleted these rows to unblock the queue. Also, the failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem and awaits further instructions from P09 on any flagged items. Additionally, the causes of 502s on the checkout page and cron drift have been addressed.
